name: update-status-full
description: S→C update.status reply (protocol 1.8, SPEC §7, D-09): every field populated — the two required ones plus BOTH optionals. Proves the D-12 nested `lastUpdate` object {target, ok, error?} round-trips, and that its nested `error` draws from the SAME closed D-11 vocabulary as update.progress.error (here `installer` — the previous attempt's setup process exited non-zero, D-24). `lastUpdate` reports the PREVIOUS attempt, read from a startup marker, because the process that would have reported that failure had already exited to let the installer replace it. The wire carries an unknown `future` key inside lastUpdate that must be IGNORED on decode (D-05) and is dropped on canonical re-encode.
